QuestInfo.name: [Golden Giveaway] The Bros are Back
QuestInfo.0:
#b#eThe Bros Are Back!#n#k

The Fairy Bros have returned for another Golden Giveaway! Log in just one hour a day, and you'll get an Attendance Stamp! Log in on weekends, and you'll get #eTWO#n attendance stamps at once! Hit an attendance goal, and you'll get amazing rewards! But it's only happening for a limited time, so don't miss it!


* Event Period
After maintenance on MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM AM/PM - MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM AM/PM UTC
